titre: Devoir de contrôle n°3 - Anglais (9ème année de base)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
Leila is a fifteen-year-old girl who loves helping others. Every Saturday, she goes to an association in her town to teach reading to children who cannot go to school. "I feel happy when I see them learn something new," she says. Last month, Leila and her friends organised a campaign to collect clothes and books for poor families. They visited many houses and shops, and people gave them a lot of things. Thanks to their effort, more than fifty families received help before winter. Leila believes that even young people can make a real difference in their community.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (8 marks)
1) What does Leila do every Saturday?   (2 marks)
2) How does she feel when she helps the children? Why?   (2 marks)
3) What did Leila and her friends organise last month?   (2 marks)
4) What does Leila believe about young people?   (2 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Put the verb into the past simple: Last month, they (organise) ______ a campaign.   (1,5 marks)
2) Complete with a relative pronoun (who / which): Leila is a girl ______ loves helping others.   (1,5 marks)
3) Give the opposite of "poor" = ______.   (1,5 marks)
4) Turn into a question: "Leila teaches reading." (Do/Does)   (1,5 marks)

III. WRITING (6 marks)
Write a short paragraph (about 8 lines) about a way young people can help their community (helping the poor, cleaning the environment, teaching others…). Explain what they can do and why it is important.
